answer: Canary bribes: the protocol itself anonymously posts collusion offers, like a forum thread promising 50 POA to any account that copies a hidden answer or echoes a coordinated vote. Each offer carries a unique signal phrase, so any identity that acts on it is caught and its stake slashed. Sybil farms depend on cheap coordination, but now every offer may be a trap: an attacker must crack each walnut of a deal by hand or forgo collusion entirely, losing the scale that made clones pay.
